The '''Sixteenth Legislative Assembly of Madhya Pradesh''' was constituted after the [[2023 Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly election|2023 Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly Election]] which were concluded in November 2023.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Madhya Pradesh election 2023 dates, full schedule, result: All you need to know|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/madhya-pradesh-assembly-polls-2023/story/madhya-pradesh-assembly-election-dates-counting-of-votes-poll-schedule-2446397-2023-10-09|website=India Today|language=en|date=9 October 2023}}</ref> The results was declared on 3 December 2023.<ref>{{Cite news|title=Madhya Pradesh To Vote In Single Phase On November 17, Result On December 3|url=https://news.abplive.com/elections/mp-election-2023-dates-madhya-pradesh-assembly-elections-2023-full-schedule-voting-counting-result-date-1633554|website=ABP LIVE|language=en|date=9 October 2023}}</ref>
